conventions.statement: When l₀ is not a member of L.lattice, the condition l = l₀ is never triggered, and VTask.weierstrassPExcept L l₀ z equals the full Weierstrass ℘ sum over all lattice points.
conventions.note: The exception is vacuous for non-lattice values of l₀.

conventions.point: Division by zero for l = 0 in the correction term
conventions.statement: The correction term 1/l^2 at l = 0 evaluates to 0 by Lean's junk-value convention for division by zero on ℂ, so the l = 0 summand (when l₀ ≠ 0) reduces to 1/z^2.
conventions.note: Matches the standard Weierstrass normalisation where the zero lattice point contributes only its principal part.

facts.statement: ∀ (L : PeriodPair) (l₀ z : ℂ), VTask.weierstrassPExcept L l₀ z + (1 / (z - l₀) ^ 2 - 1 / l₀ ^ 2) = ∑' l : L.lattice, (1 / (z - l) ^ 2 - 1 / (l : ℂ) ^ 2)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∃ (L : PeriodPair) (l₀ z : ℂ), VTask.weierstrassPExcept L l₀ z ≠ ∑' l : L.lattice, (1 / (z - l) ^ 2 - 1 / (l : ℂ) ^ 2)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (L : PeriodPair) (l₀ z : ℂ), (∀ l : L.lattice, (l : ℂ) ≠ l₀) → VTask.weierstrassPExcept L l₀ z = ∑' l : L.lattice, (1 / (z - l) ^ 2 - 1 / (l : ℂ) ^ 2)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (L : PeriodPair) (l₀ z w : ℂ), z = w → VTask.weierstrassPExcept L l₀ z = VTask.weierstrassPExcept L l₀ w

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ¬ ∀ (L : PeriodPair) (l₀ z : ℂ), VTask.weierstrassPExcept L l₀ z = ∑' l : L.lattice, (1 / (z - l) ^ 2 - 1 / (l : ℂ) ^ 2)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (L : PeriodPair) (l₀ l₁ z : ℂ), l₀ = l₁ → VTask.weierstrassPExcept L l₀ z = VTask.weierstrassPExcept L l₁ z

facts.statement: ¬ ∀ (L : PeriodPair) (l₀ z : ℂ) (hl : ∃ l : L.lattice, (l : ℂ) = l₀), VTask.weierstrassPExcept L l₀ z = ∑' l : L.lattice, (1 / (z - l) ^ 2 - 1 / (l : ℂ) ^ 2)

facts.instance: ∀ (L : PeriodPair) (l₀ z : ℂ) (hl : ∃ l : L.lattice, (l : ℂ) = l₀), VTask.weierstrassPExcept L l₀ z = ∑' l : L.lattice, (1 / (z - l) ^ 2 - 1 / (l : ℂ) ^ 2)
facts.violated_property: The l₀ summand is suppressed (set to zero) rather than included
